entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit Customer Support, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I need to return something. I have this... VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I'm just so confused by the website, I don't know what to do.
I can certainly help you look into a return. Just to be sure I'm understanding correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the band or more of a preference?
Oh, no, it works fine, I think. We never even got to use it. We had a family emergency right after we got it. My son... he ended up in the hospital for an unexpected surgery.
I'm so sorry to hear that. I hope he's recovering well.

He is, thank you. But it's just been chaos. He's supposed to be getting ready for a military deployment, and this just threw everything off. I tried looking at the policy online and saw something about a really short window... I couldn't deal with it then. Can't you just help me? This is all very overwhelming.
Of course, please don't worry. Let me just pull up your order details and check the policy for you. One moment.
Okay, I see the order here. It was delivered 26 days ago. And let me see... okay, yes. According to our policy, you're unfortunately outside the 10-day return window.
Wait, 10 days? Oh, really? The website was so confusing. That's a huge relief. So I can send it back?

Yes, absolutely. I can authorize that return for you right now and email you a prepaid shipping label. All you'll need to do is put the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it at a post office. We'll process a full refund once we receive it.
Thank you so much, Charlie. You have no idea how much I appreciate this. It's one less thing to worry about.
It's my pleasure to help. I've just sent that email with the label. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. I wish your son a speedy recovery and all the best with his deployment. Have a good rest of your day.
